title: 第9章 世外之人第10章 凄惨萧粦
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 前朝夏朝，承命六百载。
末世之年，诸帝皆是骄奢之徒，不理国事，赋敛益重，致使民力尽疲，饿殍载道。
时值乱世，妖邪横行，天下烽烟尽燃，义旗四起。
末帝姜亘登基，虽有心治国，有安邦之志，然而江山如败絮难以挽回。
当时的洛州李氏挟天时地利人和，武力定乾坤，才有了如今的大晋王朝。
而夏朝的最后血脉，在新朝中流离失所，最初还有复国之志，但后来逐渐没了消息，消失在了历史长河里。
最近这百年，朝廷也没去管夏朝姜氏，连一直挂在帝京盘龙苑的【诛邪榜】都将姜氏撤了下去。
或许是不想在文人儒士的笔下落得个赶尽杀绝的残忍形象吧。
至于前朝姜氏，近百年来一点讯息也无，不少朝廷中人闲暇笑谈，莫不是早已死绝，断了传承？
结果却是——
潜藏在这方桃花源之中！
若是旁人，此刻恐怕早已兴奋若狂，只要到州府举报了姜氏藏匿之地，可得千金，封万户侯，从前荣华富贵享受不尽。
但裴苏却只是稍有些意外而已。
并无半分为皇室李家赶尽杀绝的想法。
虽然裴家累世公卿，在朝廷根深蒂固，他裴苏更是从小受尽朝廷宠爱，圣眷极深。
但他的内心却丝毫没有忠君的思想。
不仅仅是因为他二世为人，还因为……裴家这千年古世家对他从小的教育也是如此。
而国子监那帮整日念叨着忠君报国，报效天恩的寒门士子，清流党羽。
裴苏露出一丝冷笑。
忠君忠君！
当朝陛下都闭关崆峒山二十载，太子被架空，皇后垂帘听政，朝廷大权全然落在了一个外姓女子身上。
也没见有多少士子愿意为势微的天子李家仗义死节……
裴苏定了定心神，重新把目光放在远处的桃林。
随即他再次进入涅隐，悄然跟了上去，宛如轻鸿飞羽，飒沓流星。
赵岚再次清醒的时候，发现自己正躺在一个木椅上，四周是竹屋与溪流，好生和谐清净。
他连忙起身，瞧见一个侍女急忙忙朝远处走去，还高喊：“殿下，他醒了，他醒了。”
下一刻，赵岚又看见了那个宛如存在于梦境中的身影，缓缓朝他走来。
是...是她！
不是梦。

;;
The previous dynasty, the Xia Dynasty, had been appointed for six hundred years.
In the last years, all the emperors were arrogant and extravagant. They ignored the affairs of the state and squandered wealth and wealth, causing the people to be exhausted and starved to death.
It is a time of troubled times, evil spirits are rampant, wars are burning in the world, and flags of righteousness are rising everywhere.
The last emperor, Jiang Gen, came to the throne. Although he was determined to govern the country and had the ambition to stabilize the country, the country was like a ruin and it was difficult to recover.
At that time, the Li family of Luozhou used the right time, place, people, and force to determine the world, and only then did the Jin Dynasty come into being.
The last bloodline of the Xia Dynasty was displaced in the new dynasty. At first, it still had the ambition to restore the country, but then gradually disappeared from the news and disappeared in the long river of history.
In the past hundred years, the imperial court has not paid attention to the Jiang family of the Xia Dynasty, and even removed the Jiang family from the [Extermination of Evil List] that had been hanging in the Panlong Garden of the Imperial Capital.
Perhaps it was because he did not want to end up with a cruel image of killing everyone in the writings of literati and Confucian scholars.
As for the Jiang family of the previous dynasty, there has been no news at all in the past hundred years. Many people in the court chatted leisurely. Could it be that they have died long ago and their inheritance has been cut off?
The result was——
Hidden in this peach blossom garden!
Anyone else would have been wildly excited at this moment. As long as he went to the state capital to report Jiang's hiding place, he could get thousands of gold, become a marquis, and enjoy endless wealth and wealth.
But Pei Su was just a little surprised.
There is no idea of ​​dividing the royal family and killing them all.
Although the Pei family had been ministers for many generations and had deep roots in the imperial court, Pei Su had been favored by the imperial court since he was a child and was deeply favored by the emperor.
But there was no thought of loyalty to the emperor in his heart.
Not only because of his second generation, but also because... the Pei family, a thousand-year-old family, has given him the same education since childhood.
But the group of poor men and women in the Imperial College who talk about being loyal to the emperor and serving the country and repaying heaven's kindness all day long are pure members of the party.
Pei Su showed a sneer.
Loyal to the king, loyal to the king!
At that time, His Majesty had been in seclusion in Kongtong Mountain for twenty years. The prince was sidelined and the queen listened behind the curtain. The power of the court fell entirely on a woman with a foreign surname.
I don’t see many scholars who are willing to die for the sake of the weak Emperor Li’s family...
Pei Su calmed down and focused his attention on the peach forest in the distance again.
Then he entered Nirvana again and followed quietly, like a flying feather or a shooting star.
······
When Zhao Lan woke up again, she found that she was lying on a wooden chair, surrounded by bamboo houses and streams, so harmonious and pure.
He stood up quickly and saw a maid hurriedly walking away, shouting: "Your Highness, he's awake, he's awake."
The next moment, Zhao Lan saw the figure that seemed to exist in a dream again, slowly walking towards him.
Yes...it's her!
Not a dream.
